camel_example: aliyun bdrc GET /api/v1/tasks --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken cae0000000000699 --MaxResults 10 --TaskType UPDATE_RESOURCES --TaskStatus RUNNING --header "Content-Type=application/json"
kebab_example: aliyun bdrc describe-tasks --task-status RUNNING --next-token cae0000000000699 --max-results 10 --task-type UPDATE_RESOURCES --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTasks

parameters.help_en: Specifies the status of tasks to query. If this parameter is omitted, the API returns tasks in all states. Valid values: `CREATED`, `RUNNING`, `COMPLETE`, `FAILED`, `EXPIRED`, and `CANCELED`
parameters.help_zh: CREATED: 创建, RUNNING: 正在执行, COMPLETE: 任务成功完成, FAILED: 任务执行失败, EXPIRED: 任务已过期, CANCELED: 任务已被取消
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: A pagination token. To retrieve the next page of results, set this parameter to the `NextToken` value from the response of the previous API call. For more information, see the API description above
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。有关本接口查看返回数据的设置方式，请参见上文接口说明
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. The valid range is 10 to 500. If this parameter is omitted or its value is less than 10, a default value of 10 is used. Values greater than 500 are treated as 500
parameters.help_zh: 返回的最大数。取值范围：10~500。默认值：当不设置值或者设置的值小于10，默认值为10。当设置的值大于500时，默认值为500
parameters.name: max_results

Content.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的记录集合

CompleteTime.description_en: The task's completion time, represented as a Unix timestamp in seconds
CompleteTime.description_zh: 任务完成时间。Unix时间戳格式，单位：秒

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the task fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

ExecutionId.description_en: The execution ID. This parameter is currently unused and returns an empty string

ExpireTime.description_en: The task's expiration time, represented as a Unix timestamp in seconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 过期时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位：秒

Progress.description_en: The progress of the task, ranging from 0 to 10,000

StartTime.description_en: The task's start time, represented as a Unix timestamp in seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位：秒

TaskPriority.description_en: The task priority. Valid values: `HIGH` (high-priority, for user-initiated tasks) and `LOW` (low-priority, for background tasks)
TaskPriority.description_zh: HIGH: 高优先级，一般为用户前台触发的任务, LOW: 低优先级，一般为后台任务
TaskPriority.title_zh: HIGH: 高优先级，一般为用户前台触发的任务, LOW: 低优先级，一般为后台任务

TaskStatus.description_en: The task status. Valid values: `CREATED`, `RUNNING`, `COMPLETE`, `FAILED`, `EXPIRED`, and `CANCELED`
TaskStatus.description_zh: CREATED: 创建, RUNNING: 正在执行, COMPLETE: 任务成功完成, FAILED: 任务执行失败, EXPIRED: 任务已过期, CANCELED: 任务已被取消
TaskStatus.title_zh: CREATED: 创建, RUNNING: 正在执行, COMPLETE: 任务成功完成, FAILED: 任务执行失败, EXPIRED: 任务已过期, CANCELED: 任务已被取消

TaskType.description_en: The task type. Valid values: `TEST`, `UPDATE_RESOURCES`, and `CHECK_RULES`
TaskType.description_zh: TEST: 测试任务, UPDATE_RESOURCES: 更新资源和状态, CHECK_RULES
TaskType.title_zh: TEST: 测试任务, UPDATE_RESOURCES: 更新资源和状态, CHECK_RULES

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results. If this parameter is empty, no more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 用来表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_zh: 用来表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries matching the request criteria. This parameter is optional and is not returned by default
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
TotalCount.title_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
